document: Smart civil status card (بطاقة الأحوال المدنية الذكية)
office: the Civil Status and Passports Department

routes.label: in person at a Civil Status and Passports Department office (20 minutes at the counter; an SMS says when the printed card is ready)

note: The Civil Status and Passports Department's service guide: a Jordanian applies in person at one of its offices, with a guardian's consent under 16; iris, fingerprints and photograph are taken, the legal fees are paid at the cashier, the card is printed at a printing centre and an SMS tells the citizen it is ready; the service takes 20 minutes at the counter. The guide's fee, read 2026-10-30, is 2 dinars for a first card and 2 for a renewal (a 10-dinar fine for anyone who reaches 18 without a card isn't modelled); the card's term and the time to the printed card weren't found.
